summary: This table presents the consolidated financial data for Infosys for the first quarter of fiscal year 2025, highlighting key metrics such as quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) growth of 3.6% and year-over-year (YoY) growth of 2.5%. The operating margin stands at 21.1%, with a notable 7.0% increase in earnings per share (EPS) in rupee terms. Revenue is segmented by business areas, with financial services leading at 27.5%, followed by retail and communication. Geographically, North America contributes the most to revenue at 58.9%. The client data section reveals a total of 1,867 active clients, with significant contributions from the top client segments. Overall, the data reflects stable growth and a strong client base.
